prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 3.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1293
Claimant:
Lorraine Allen
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
March 23, 2024
Reported today by the insured driver, who says a vehicle merged into the lane during a lane change and scraped
along the side of the insured car. The claimant's counsel has also sent a letter of representation, so all furtehr contact
will go through that office.
April 29, 2024
Reviewed the photos submitted with the first notice. They show the damage on the passenger side and confirm some
of the details in the driver's account, though they do not show the moment of contact.
May 31, 2024
Spoke with the insured, who confirmed the policy is in force and that the driver listed on the policy was operating the
vehicle at the time. No earlier damage to the vehicle has been reported or fuond in the file.
July 5, 2024
Police report obtained. It places the claimant in the other vehicle and records the same location and approximate
sequence of events the insured described. No independent witnesses were identified in the report or in any statement
since.
July 30, 2024
Appraiser inspected the insured vehicle. The damage pattern matches the described impact, and the repair estimate
reflects panels and components consistent with a sideswipe.
August 28, 2024
Received a medical summary from counsel listing neck and back strain as the injuries. The kind and force of the
impact fit these complaints well, and no prior injury to the same body areas appears in the records supplied so far.
September 28, 2024
Claimant gave a recorded statement through counsel. The account matched the one given in the initial call, including
the sequence of the lane change and the position of both vehicles.
October 1, 2024
Treatment records have arrived and show regular visits, with new services added over the following weeks. The
volume of care is well above what is typically needed for a strain of this type, so the file is being flagged for medical
review.
October 19, 2024
Spoke with counsel about the growing treatment list and asked for the referral notes and imaging that support the
additional services. Counsel said the records would be sent but gave no timeline.
October 25, 2024
Reviewed the policy history. The coverage on the insured vehicle was active at the date of loss, and nothing in the file
suggests the damage occurred before the coverage started.
November 11, 2024
Claimant's account has stayed consistent across every contact so far, including the call, the statement, and the
medical intake. The file still rests on the photos, the police report, and the physical damage, with no independent
witness to the cnotact itself.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
